title: Schema for the map tile matches data file: tile sides with the same art but for their number pill (interchangeable)

tile_id.description: Foreign key to the tile in data/map-tiles.json: the one earlier in that file.

other_tile_id.description: Foreign key to the other tile in data/map-tiles.json, later in that file.

other_side.description: The side of other_tile_id with the same art as tile_id's side. Both sides are stored with their number pill upright, and the art lines up as stored: no turn.
